movie:1570282.name: This Is I
movie:1570282.overview: Bullied for wanting to be an idol, Kenji finds belonging in a cabaret and help from a trailblazing doctor, emerging onstage as her true self, Ai Haruna.

series:60625.name: Rick and Morty
series:60625.overview: Follows a sociopathic genius scientist who drags his inherently timid grandson on adventures across the universe.

series:60574.name: Peaky Blinders
series:60574.overview: A gangster family epic set in 1919 Birmingham, England and centered on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby, who means to move up in the world.

series:65930.name: My Hero Academia
series:65930.originalTitle: 僕のヒーローアカデミア
series:65930.overview: Izuku has dreamt of being a hero all his life—a lofty goal for anyone, but especially challenging for a kid with no superpowers. That’s right, in a world where eighty percent of the population has some kind of super-powered "quirk," Izuku was unlucky enough to be born completely normal. But that’s not enough to stop him from enrolling in one of the world’s most prestigious hero academies.

series:95479.name: JUJUTSU KAISEN
series:95479.overview: Yuji Itadori is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a classmate who has been attacked by curses, he eats the finger of Ryomen Sukuna, taking the curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with Ryomen Sukuna. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Satoru Gojo, Itadori is admitted to Tokyo Jujutsu High School, an organization that fights the curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a curse to exorcise a curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

series:65334.name: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
series:65334.originalTitle: Miraculous, les aventures de Ladybug et Chat Noir
series:65334.overview: Marinette and Adrien, two Parisian teenagers, are entrusted with powerful jewels in order to transform into superheroes Ladybug and Cat Noir. But neither hero knows the other's true identity — or that they're classmates!

series:79744.name: The Rookie
series:79744.overview: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being an LAPD officer. As the force's oldest rookie, he's met with skepticism from some higher-ups who see him as just a walking midlife crisis.

series:387.name: SpongeBob SquarePants
series:387.overview: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

series:56570.name: Outlander
series:56570.overview: The story of Claire Randall, a married combat nurse from 1945 who is mysteriously swept back in time to 1743, where she is immediately thrown into an unknown world where her life is threatened. When she is forced to marry Jamie, a chivalrous and romantic young Scottish warrior, a passionate affair is ignited that tears Claire's heart between two vastly different men in two irreconcilable lives.

series:58841.name: Chicago P.D.
series:58841.overview: A riveting police drama about the men and women of the Chicago Police Department's District 21 who put it all on the line to serve and protect their community. District 21 is made up of two distinctly different groups: the uniformed cops who patrol the beat and go head-to-head with the city's street crimes and the Intelligence Unit that combats the city's major offenses - organized crime, drug trafficking, high profile murders and beyond.

series:94664.name: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
series:94664.originalTitle: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～
series:94664.overview: When a 34-year-old underachiever gets run over by a truck, his story doesn't end there. Reincarnated in a new world as an infant, Rudy will seize every opportunity to live the life he's always wanted. Armed with new friends, some freshly acquired magical abilities, and the courage to do the things he's always dreamed of, he's embarking on an epic adventure—with all of his past experience intact!

series:67075.name: Mob Psycho 100
series:67075.overview: Shigeo Kageyama, a.k.a. "Mob," is a boy who has trouble expressing himself, but who happens to be a powerful esper. Mob is determined to live a normal life and keeps his ESP suppressed, but when his emotions surge to a level of 100%, something terrible happens to him! As he's surrounded by false espers, evil spirits, and mysterious organizations, what will Mob think? What choices will he make?

series:103540.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
series:103540.overview: Percy Jackson is on a dangerous quest. Outrunning monsters and outwitting gods, he must journey across America to return Zeus's master bolt and stop an all-out war. With the help of his friends Annabeth and Grover, Percy's journey will lead him closer to the answers he seeks: how to fit into a world where he feels out of place, and who he's destined to be.

series:57532.name: PAW Patrol
series:57532.overview: Marshall, Rocky, Rubble, Zuma and Skye are doing their best to protect the people of their town. Led by Ryder, a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy, each of them is equipped with special equipment and together they help anyone who finds themselves in trouble. No task is too big for them and no puppy is too small.

series:12225.name: Peppa Pig
series:12225.overview: Peppa Pig is an energetic piggy who lives with Mummy, Daddy, and little brother George. She loves to jump in mud puddles and make loud snorting noises.

series:45140.name: Teen Titans Go!
series:45140.overview: Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg return in all-new, comedic adventures. They may be super heroes who save the world every day ... but somebody still has to do the laundry!

series:220542.name: The Apothecary Diaries
series:220542.overview: Maomao lived a peaceful life with her apothecary father. Until one day, she's sold as a lowly servant to the emperor's palace. But she wasn't meant for a compliant life among royalty. So when imperial heirs fall ill, she decides to step in and find a cure! This catches the eye of Jinshi, a handsome palace official who promotes her. Now, she's making a name for herself solving medical mysteries!

series:157741.name: Landman
series:157741.overview: Set in the proverbial boomtowns of West-Texas and a modern-day tale of fortune-seeking in the world of oil rigs, the series is an upstairs/downstairs story of roughnecks and wildcat billionaires that are fueling a boom so big it’s reshaping our climate, our economy and our geopolitics.

series:14929.name: Heartland
series:14929.overview: Life is hard on the Flemings' ranch in the Alberta foothills where abused or neglected horses find refuge with a kind, hard-working family. Debts abound and the bank is about to foreclose. Can they keep the ranch running?

series:117465.name: Hell's Paradise
series:117465.overview: For a chance at a pardon, a ninja assassin joins other condemned criminals on a journey to a mysterious island to retrieve an elixir of immortality.

series:126027.name: Ghosts
series:126027.overview: Samantha and Jay throw caution to the wind when they convert their recently inherited country estate into a bed-and-breakfast. Call it mislaid plans. Not only is the place falling apart, but it’s also inhabited by spirits of previous residents -- whom only Samantha can see and hear.

series:46080.name: Masha and the Bear
series:46080.overview: Masha is an energetic three-year-old who can’t seem to keep herself out of trouble. Bear is a warm, fatherly figure that does his best to guide his friend and keep her from harm, often ending up the unintended victim of her misadventures.

series:312359.name: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
series:312359.originalTitle: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス
series:312359.overview: When Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens in search of a worthy rival, Goku and his friends face an epic battle to stop him from destroying Earth. Remastered and re-edited version of Dragon Ball Super.

series:203737.name: 【OSHI NO KO】
series:203737.overview: A small-town doctor gets sucked into the ruthless world of show business when he crosses paths with a popular teen idol who holds a secret.

series:69557.name: Fauda
series:69557.overview: A top Israeli agent comes out of retirement to hunt for a Palestinian militant he thought he'd killed, setting a chaotic chain of events into motion.

series:196944.name: My Happy Marriage
series:196944.overview: Miyo's abusive family deems her worthless – but together with her powerful husband-to-be, her true self and hidden powers slowly begin to shine.

series:124394.name: Power Book III: Raising Kanan
series:124394.overview: Set in South Jamaica, Queens, in 1991, this prequel to "Power" revolves around the coming of age of Kanan Stark.

series:296206.name: Agent Kim Reactivated
series:296206.overview: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

series:119769.name: Taxi Driver
series:119769.overview: A former special forces soldier delivers revenge for victims of injustice while working for a secret organization that fronts as a taxi company.

series:208569.name: Will Trent
series:208569.overview: Special Agent Will Trent was abandoned at birth and endured a harsh coming-of-age in Atlanta's overwhelmed foster care system. Determined to make sure no one feels as he did, he now has the highest clearance rate.

series:259140.name: Ranma1/2
series:259140.overview: Akane Tendo meets her new fiancé, Ranma Saotome, a martial arts prodigy with a twist: he magically transforms into a girl upon touching cold water.

series:1549.name: WWE Friday Night SmackDown
series:1549.overview: The superstars of World Wrestling Entertainment's "SmackDown" brand collide each and every Friday on WWE Friday Night SmackDown.

series:123591.name: The Smurfs
series:123591.overview: Blue and small, standing only three apples high, the Smurfs might be hard to tell apart at first. However, each Smurf is a distinct individual with his or her own personality, their names say it all

series:31991.name: WWE NXT
series:31991.overview: Wrestlers will portray heroes or villains as they follow a series of events that build tension and culminate in a wrestling match or series of matches.

series:253811.name: Tougen Anki
series:253811.overview: After a Momotaro assassin suddenly kills his adoptive father, Shiki vows to avenge him. But first, he must learn to control his newly awakened Oni blood.

series:207347.name: Blue Box
series:207347.overview: Taiki Inomata loves badminton, but he has a long way to go before he can reach nationals. When Taiki sees upperclassman Chinatsu Kano practicing her heart out on the girls’ basketball team, he falls for her hard. After an unexpected turn of events brings the two closer together, sports might not be the first thing on their minds anymore!

series:279388.name: Pursuit of Jade
series:279388.overview: This drama follows Fan Changyu, a butcher’s daughter, and Xie Zheng, a fallen noble seeking revenge. Their fake marriage turns into true love, but war tears them apart. Determined, Fan Changyu wields her butcher’s knife on the battlefield, searching for justice and her husband. Meanwhile, Xie Zheng reclaims his title, fighting to protect his country and love. Reunited in battle, they stand together, defying fate, uncovering the truth, and returning home without forgetting their vows.

series:312949.name: Chainsmoker Cat
series:312949.overview: Catgirl Yani struggles to pay her rent and keep a job while feeding her smoking habit. As her loved ones' concerns grow, she must rethink her future.

series:134667.name: Reincarnated as a Sword
series:134667.overview: Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Together, the strange duo's journey has only just begun!

series:283428.name: The Ramparts of Ice
series:283428.overview: Weighed down by memories she can't shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm's length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.

series:293610.name: Doctor X: Mafia in White
series:293610.overview: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

series:256711.name: The Rainmaker
series:256711.overview: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor goes head to head with courtroom lion Leo Drummond as well as his law school girlfriend, Sarah. Rudy, along with his boss, Bruiser, and her disheveled paralegal, Deck, uncovers two connected conspiracies surrounding the mysterious death of their client's son.

series:299952.name: The Early Spring
series:299952.overview: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

series:218038.name: Vivant
series:218038.overview: Yusuke Nogi of Ryosho's Energy Development Division said that 10 times the official down payment was mistakenly sent to GFL, a local infrastructure company involved in a solar energy plant to be built in the Balkan Republic in Central Asia. Suspected of involvement, he heads to the Balkan Republic to collect the difference of $90 million. With the cooperation of his CIA friend Sam, Nogi obtained information that the terrorist al-Zaer had laundered the full amount of the contract money into diamonds and brought it out.

series:300146.name: Where the Mask Ends
series:300146.overview: An ambitious street urchin seizes the chance to impersonate a noblewoman, and becomes the bride of a wounded war hero who seems sure to die. But when her comatose husband awakens, she must navigate deadly schemes, win his heart through cunning, and uncover her royal heritage to triumph over rivals and rise from gutter to glory.

series:155780.name: Batwheels
series:155780.overview: The Batwheels are a team of sentient super-powered crimefighting vehicles that help Batman, Robin and Batgirl—as well as a host of additional DC Super Heroes—keep Gotham City safe. Created only recently by the Batcomputer, our mechanized heroes must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super-team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

series:293607.name: 100 Days of Deception
series:293607.overview: Hoping for freedom, Gyeongseong's top pickpocket infiltrates the Japanese colonial government to steal secrets — only to fall for her target's son.

series:335981.name: Cunk on Cinema
series:335981.overview: Philomena Cunk asks experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema, from the invention of the camera, to the New Wave filmmakers of the 60s, right up to the entrance of CGI and what the future of AI holds. Cunk will attempt to demystify it all while sitting in lumpy seats with stale popcorn, asking herself where did cinema come from? And why? What does it want? And why can't it tell us?

series:19845.name: Pororo the Little Penguin
series:19845.overview: Fun adventures await in the forest named Porong Porong Village where Pororo and friends live. New friends show up in the village and many exciting things happen in the forest. Our playful little gentoo penguin Pororo, naughty spinosaurus Crong, sweet and lovely American beaver Loopy, cheerful and sporty Adélie penguin girl Petty, clever fennec fox Eddy, strong minikaniko Rody, trustworthy polar bear Poby, happy-go-lucky hummingbird Harry, magical dragon wizard Tong-Tong, and a red sedan car Tu-Tu live in this snow-covered wonderland.

series:314255.name: The Jinn Wedding
series:314255.overview: What begins as a vibrant, joy-filled Kuwaiti wedding turns into a terrifying spiral of psychological horror, drawing viewers into a gripping world of fear, mystery, and dark folklore.

movie:1265609.name: War Machine
movie:1265609.overview: On one last grueling mission during Army Ranger training, a combat engineer must lead his unit in a fight against a giant otherworldly killing machine.

movie:1306368.name: The Rip
movie:1306368.overview: Trust frays when a team of Miami cops discovers millions in cash inside a run-down stash house, calling everyone — and everything — into question.

movie:875828.name: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
movie:875828.overview: After his estranged son gets embroiled in a Nazi plot, self-exiled gangster Tommy Shelby must return to Birmingham to save his family — and his nation.

movie:1034716.name: People We Meet on Vacation
movie:1034716.overview: Poppy's a free spirit. Alex loves a plan. After years of summer vacations, these polar-opposite pals wonder if they could be a perfect romantic match.

movie:1268127.name: Humint
movie:1268127.overview: A South Korean agent hunts a drug ring in Russia and goes head-to-head with a North Korean operative — pulling both into peril and tangled secrets.

movie:1428862.name: Firebreak
movie:1428862.overview: Little Lide disappears in the forest while her family packs up their home. As a fire breaks out, her mother must race to reach her before the flames do.

movie:1582770.name: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
movie:1582770.overview: As rival gangs, corrupt officials and a ruthless Major Iqbal close in, Hamza's mission for his country spirals into a bloody personal war where the line between patriot and monster disappears in the streets of Lyari.

movie:1633264.name: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
movie:1633264.overview: With rare access and no holds barred, the acclaimed documentarian investigates a growing ultra-masculine network and its controversial influencers.

movie:1620551.name: Feel My Voice
movie:1620551.overview: A teenager, the only hearing member of a deaf family, finds her voice and learns to believe in herself through her passion for singing.

movie:1575337.name: Cosmic Princess Kaguya!
movie:1575337.overview: Iroha's life gets knocked off its orbit when Kaguya, a carefree runaway from the Moon, moves in and convinces her to perform in a virtual world together.

movie:1635276.name: Eat Pray Bark
movie:1635276.overview: Five eccentric dog owners seek help in dealing with their four-legged friends. Their last hope: an intensive course with the charismatic and legendary dog trainer Nodon in the Tyrolean mountains.

movie:1628123.name: BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG
movie:1628123.overview: BTS is back. The iconic group returns to the stage for a live reunion concert to perform legendary hits and unveil brand-new tracks.

movie:1595481.name: Kidnapped: Elizabeth Smart
movie:1595481.overview: Elizabeth Smart's harrowing abduction at 14 from her family's Utah home unfolds through her own words and never-before-seen material in this documentary.

movie:1610413.name: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
movie:1610413.originalTitle: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
movie:1610413.overview: An inside look at the years of effort and craft that went into the final installment of the Duffer Brothers' generation-defining series.

movie:1359005.name: Per Aspera Ad Astra
movie:1359005.overview: Set in the near future, the story revolves around the emergence of the virtual dream reality technology "Good Dreams", which allows people to do whatever they desire within their self-created dreams. However, a crisis triggered by these dreams quietly unfolds.

movie:1261188.name: The Swedish Connection
movie:1261188.overview: Swedish Foreign Ministry bureaucrat Gösta Engzell, overlooked during WWII, rescued thousands while turning supposedly neutral Sweden into a moral force. His efforts challenged the status quo and left a lasting humanitarian legacy.

movie:1442908.name: The Singers
movie:1442908.overview: An impromptu singing contest at a dive bar turns a lonely night into a soul-baring moment of shared harmony.

movie:1276704.name: 53 Sundays
movie:1276704.overview: When three siblings agree to meet and discuss their aging father's future, their reunion spirals into bickering, bantering and reliving old grudges.

movie:1630433.name: The Red Line
movie:1630433.originalTitle: เส้นตาย สายลวง
movie:1630433.overview: Three women fall prey to a ruthless phone scam. To settle the score, they'll take on the criminal network that stole their money — and their dignity.

movie:1596291.name: Queen of Chess
movie:1596291.overview: A Hungarian girl dreams of conquering international men’s chess. After a 15-year battle against world champion Garry Kasparov and her domineering father, Judit Polgár revolutionizes the sport’s patriarchal culture to become one of the greatest chess prodigies in history and the greatest woman chess player of all time.

movie:1620991.name: The Investigation of Lucy Letby
movie:1620991.overview: An engaging and thought-provoking look at Lucy Letby, the former nurse serving life in prison after being convicted of the murders of seven infants and the attempted murders of seven others.

movie:1426964.name: State of Fear
movie:1426964.overview: As São Paulo erupts in an unprecedented wave of violence, a lawyer with underworld ties must strike a deal with the police to rescue her kidnapped niece.

movie:1389149.name: Accused
movie:1389149.overview: When a celebrated queer doctor in London is accused of sexual misconduct, her life unravels. Now under a storm of suspicion and scrutiny, her marriage fractures and the truth blurs. Her wife must decide whether to walk away, or fight for the woman the world is turning against.

movie:1268609.name: Pavane
movie:1268609.overview: Three lonely strangers meet at their department store jobs and find solace in each other's company while they explore connection and the nature of love.

movie:1629382.name: Street Flow 3
movie:1629382.overview: Grieving and facing the consequences of their crimes, the Traoré brothers get one last chance to forge a new path.

movie:1446616.name: Tu Yaa Main
movie:1446616.overview: A wannabe rapper from the outskirts of Mumbai and an affluent influencer elope to a coastal town, only to find themselves trapped in the pool of a derelict resort fighting for survival against the wrath of a ferocious crocodile.

movie:1588838.name: To the Max
movie:1588838.overview: A group of friends bonded by their love for extreme sports discovers BASE jumping in wingsuits — but feeling like flying carries the highest risks.

movie:1629369.name: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson
movie:1629369.originalTitle: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson
movie:1629369.overview: An intimate, arresting portrait of cyclist Moriah Wilson—raised by a fierce, loving family—whose singular drive becomes her superpower, carrying her to athletic brilliance and, devastatingly, toward a life cut short by murder.

movie:1599090.name: Skyscraper Live
movie:1599090.overview: No ropes. No fear. Free solo legend Alex Honnold risks it all in a high-stakes, live ascent of one of the world's tallest skyscrapers in Taipei, Taiwan.

movie:1618945.name: Yoh! Bestie
movie:1618945.overview: Thando is perpetually unlucky in love, but when her bestie returns from his travels with a fiancée in tow, she's forced to face a new emotion — jealousy.

movie:1482168.name: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel
movie:1482168.originalTitle: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel
movie:1482168.overview: Explore the formative years of the Red Hot Chili Peppers and the profound influence of original bandmate Hillel Slovak.

movie:1598785.name: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express - the Movie
movie:1598785.originalTitle: 銀河特急 ミルキー☆サブウェイ 各駅停車劇場行き
movie:1598785.overview: Six delinquents are tasked with cleaning a train as part of a community service program. But when the train suddenly takes off, chaos ensues.

movie:1561687.name: Made in Korea
movie:1561687.overview: A woman from a small town in Tamil Nadu moves to South Korea — a place she always dreamed of — but struggles to find her footing in a foreign land.

movie:1339876.name: Mardaani 3
movie:1339876.overview: Officer Shivani Shivaji Roy returns to hunt down those behind the disappearance of young girls, risking everything to bring them back alive.

movie:1596335.name: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
movie:1596335.originalTitle: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
movie:1596335.overview: A father-to-be tries to figure out what is happening with all this AI insanity, and explores the most powerful technology humanity has ever created... and what's at stake if we get it wrong.

movie:1641962.name: Untold: Chess Mates
movie:1641962.overview: Magnus Carlsen, widely regarded as the greatest chess player of all time, is challenged by Hans Niemann, a rising star who capitalizes on the meteoric growth of online chess. Niemann’s ascension culminated in an epic, controversy-shrouded victory over Carlsen at the 2022 Sinquefield Cup, which eventually led to allegations and revelations of cheating. Determined to clear his name, Niemann fights his way back to the top of the chess world, setting the stage for a high-stakes rematch with Carlsen in 2024.

movie:1397201.name: Golden Kamuy -The Abashiri Prison Raid-
movie:1397201.originalTitle: ゴールデンカムイ 網走監獄襲撃編
movie:1397201.overview: As each group pursues their mission, a fierce battle unfolds over the tattooed prisoners. Who is friend, and who is foe? The fight leads them all to Abashiri Prison, where Noppera-bo, the man who holds all the answers, is locked away...

movie:1213898.name: Border 2
movie:1213898.overview: Three idealistic soldiers in the Indian army, navy and air force face grueling combat conditions in this film set during the 1971 Indo-Pak war.

movie:1633263.name: Wonderful Nightmare
movie:1633263.overview: A high-flying, career-driven lawyer dies prematurely due to a clerical error in heaven.

movie:910850.name: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
movie:910850.originalTitle: 機動戦士ガンダム  閃光のハサウェイ キルケーの魔女
movie:910850.overview: Hathaway Noa plans his attack on the Adelaide Conference while Federation officer Kenneth Sleg prepares to defend it. With each man pursuing his own goal, Gigi Andalucia heads to Hong Kong to fulfill a role of her own.

movie:1631485.name: Strangers in the Park
movie:1631485.overview: A former communist militant and a "live and let live" man form an unlikely friendship on a park bench, sharing their life stories with humor and heart.

movie:1617908.name: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter
movie:1617908.overview: Taylor Tomlinson takes her fans to church with hilarious confessions about dating in her 30s, her dream assistant and why she refuses to use AI.

movie:1508564.name: With Love
movie:1508564.overview: Sathya reluctantly agrees to a blind date arranged by his sister and meets Monisha. They discover they attended the same school years ago. Bonding over shared memories and old crushes, they reconnect with their past and grow closer.

movie:1487320.name: The Giant Falls
movie:1487320.overview: Follows Boris, a charismatic tour guide who unexpectedly reunites with his estranged father Julián. Their tense and emotional encounters explore past wounds and the possibility of forgiveness.

movie:1542352.name: Youth
movie:1542352.overview: Youth follows Praveen, a 15-year-old boy who enters adolescence determined to find true love before school ends. As he goes through multiple relationships and heartbreaks, he slowly begins to understand what love truly means. Along the way, the experiences shape his growth, maturity, and outlook on life.

movie:1602705.name: A Letter to My Youth
movie:1602705.overview: A rebellious teen and a reserved caretaker form an unlikely bond in an orphanage as they come to terms with their painful pasts.

movie:1599078.name: Marcello Hernández: American Boy
movie:1599078.overview: Filmed in Miami, Hernández's special features his comedic take on his first-generation American upbringing before a local audience.

movie:1608982.name: From the Ashes: The Pit
movie:1608982.overview: Trapped in an underground pit during a storm, three students from an all-girls school must confront their personal conflicts as they fight to survive.

movie:1530941.name: Gintama the Movie 2026: Yoshiwara in Flames
movie:1530941.originalTitle: 新劇場版 銀魂 -吉原大炎上-
movie:1530941.overview: Upon meeting a young boy named Seita who makes a living as a pickpocket, Gintoki discovers that he is pickpocketing out of a desire to meet his long-lost mother, Hinowa, Yoshiwara's number one courtesan. Gintoki and his friends venture to Yoshiwara to fulfill Seita's wish, but standing in their way is Housen, the Night King who rules Yoshiwara.

movie:1641961.name: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom
movie:1641961.originalTitle: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom
movie:1641961.overview: This documentary traces the life of Lamar Odom, from his rise to NBA fame and marriage to Khloé Kardashian to his near-fatal overdose in a Nevada brothel.

movie:1613335.name: Miracle: The Boys of '80
movie:1613335.overview: This is the story of the “Miracle on Ice,” when the 1980 US Hockey Team beat the USSR in the Olympic semi-finals at the height of the Cold War to bring home a gold medal. Their iconic underdog story is told with never-before-seen 16mm footage and firsthand reflections from the players who were brought back to the scene of their historic victory.

movie:1282440.name: Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos
movie:1282440.overview: Chronically unsuccessful MI7 operative Happy Patel is finally assigned a mission in Goa, where he uncovers his Indian roots and must rescue a high-profile scientist from crime lord Mama. Unaware of his Indian heritage and armed with a comically British accent, Happy’s blunders trigger a string of chaotic mishaps that could lead him to expose a criminal network.

movie:1536559.name: Double Happiness
movie:1536559.overview: Tim Kao, the meticulous head chef of a five-star hotel in Taiwan, is set to marry his Hong Kong fiance Daisy Wu. But Tim’s divorced parents refuse to attend the same ceremony, and each insists on hosting their own. To complicate things further, the Feng Shui master chooses the same auspicious date for both events. Tim, Daisy, their wedding planner Regina, and the best man Tsai must orchestrate two weddings simultaneously in the same hotel, without either parent finding out. Surrounded by a strict father, a demanding mother, and a cast of sharp-tongued relatives, Tim must confront the traumas of his upbringing and ask himself: is he truly ready to start a new family of his own?

movie:972232.name: K-Pops!
movie:972232.overview: A washed-up musician travels to Korea to write for K-pop stars, discovering that his long-lost son is set to front one of the country’s hottest new groups. He then jumps at the opportunity to capitalize on his son’s stardom for his own renaissance, but learns that fatherhood is much more fulfilling and meaningful than stardom.

movie:1451078.name: Raakaasa
movie:1451078.overview: Returning home after a decade, an NRI chasing romance inadvertently awakens an ancient darkness long feared by his village. As the threat intensifies, love turns deadly and life hangs in the balance.

movie:1241693.name: Do Deewane Seher Mein
movie:1241693.overview: Two socially awkward millennials in Mumbai find love while struggling with self-acceptance. As they battle insecurities and societal pressure, their journey takes them from city chaos to mountain serenity.

movie:1636918.name: The Plastic Detox
movie:1636918.overview: This eye-opening documentary follows six couples with unexplained infertility as they lower their exposure to plastics in hopes it helps them conceive.

movie:1407432.name: Anaganaga Oka Raju
movie:1407432.overview: A lazy, entitled brat who wants to lead an easy life is in for a rude shock that changes the course of his life.

movie:1561758.name: It Takes a Village
movie:1561758.overview: When financial trouble forces Halina to call off her wedding, her friends and family decide to hatch a wild plan to bring in tourist money.

movie:1644807.name: Harry Styles. One Night in Manchester.
movie:1644807.originalTitle: Harry Styles. One Night in Manchester.
movie:1644807.overview: In a special one off concert in Manchester, recorded on the evening of March 6, Harry Styles played his new album, ‘Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally.' for the very first time.

movie:869140.name: Thalaivar Thambi Thalaimaiyil
movie:869140.overview: A village official attending a wedding becomes entangled in an escalating family dispute over power and old resentments, testing his leadership as he tries to contain the situation.

movie:1533029.name: The Loved One
movie:1533029.overview: Ten years later, former lovers Ellie and Eric meet again to trace the memories of a love and sorrow that never went away.

movie:1628484.name: Katt Williams: The Last Report
movie:1628484.overview: Back for his fourth Netflix stand-up special, comedy icon Katt Williams delivers his famously bold takes on conspiracies, celebrities and the world at large in this electrifying set.

movie:1649887.name: Barbara - Becoming Shirin David
movie:1649887.overview: Shirin David. Babsi. Barbara. Meet the woman behind the rap star as she balances fame, business and her identity in this intimate, emotional documentary.

movie:1595507.name: Vadh 2
movie:1595507.overview: A police officer's pursuit of truth in a shocking prison crime intertwines with the lives of a widowed prison guard and a soon to be released inmate, unravelling a web of morality and redemption.

movie:868668.name: Ustaad Bhagat Singh
movie:868668.overview: A tribal boy is shaped by the values of his teacher, who gives him the name 'Bhagat Singh'. He grows up deeply rooted in strong morals, which guide his actions throughout his life.He stands firm against injustice and takes on powerful evil forces, even when facing overwhelming odds.

movie:1665224.name: Sheng Wang: Purple
movie:1665224.overview: Sheng Wang shares his thoughts on edible bras, braving the ghosts in your house and guarding expensive berries from your friends' kids.

movie:1457866.name: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
movie:1457866.originalTitle: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
movie:1457866.overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

movie:940009.name: Ray Gunn
movie:940009.overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

movie:1595124.name: Steps
movie:1595124.overview: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

movie:1591961.name: My Crazy Feminist Girlfriend
movie:1591961.originalTitle: 僕の狂ったフェミ彼女
movie:1591961.overview: After seven years, his ex returns as an unapologetic feminist, clashing head-on without compromising "love" nor "rights."

movie:1439594.name: Chatha Pacha: The Ring of Rowdies
movie:1439594.originalTitle: ചത്താ പച്ച: The Ring of Rowdies
movie:1439594.overview: In the heart of Fort Kochi, three brothers and their crew of unlikely misfits stumble into the wild world of WWE-style costumed wrestling. What begins as a scrappy hustle soon explodes into a riot of masks, egos, and full-blown madness, all set against the backdrop of a city that never plays by the rules. But can their brotherhood survive when the real fight begins outside the ropes?

movie:1639000.name: Famous Last Words: Eric Dane
movie:1639000.overview: In this emotional interview, the late actor and ALS advocate Eric Dane shared his final message for the world — knowing it would not air until his death.

movie:1492341.name: Noah Kahan: Out of Body
movie:1492341.overview: After rocketing to global fame, singer-songwriter Noah Kahan returns to his Vermont roots to get back in tune with himself.

movie:1641817.name: Mark Normand: None Too Pleased
movie:1641817.overview: Mark Normand turns married life, fatherhood and hot-button topics into rapid-fire punchlines in this witty free-for-all where nothing is off limits.

movie:1489931.name: Suzzanna: Witchcraft
movie:1489931.originalTitle: Suzzanna: Santet Dosa di Atas Dosa
movie:1489931.overview: Suzzanna is determined to exact revenge on Bisman, the cruel village ruler who killed her father with black magic. To achieve this, she learns black magic, but realizes Bisman's power is immense. In the midst of her efforts, Suzzanna falls in love with Pramuja, a religious man who doesn't know her secret, forcing her to choose between pursuing her revenge or sacrificing him for love.

movie:1599087.name: Mike Epps: Delusional
movie:1599087.overview: Follows comedian Mike Epps as he discusses how a little delusion and a lot of hustle made him a star.

movie:1403737.name: Funky
movie:1403737.overview: A debut director who falls in love with his producer's daughter

movie:1444032.name: Masthishka Maranam
movie:1444032.overview: Plunging into a virtual reminiscence challenge to assuage his sorrow, a heartbroken dad uncovers a shocking revelation about Frida Soman, his long-admired icon and globally beloved luminary.

movie:1555160.name: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
movie:1555160.originalTitle: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
movie:1555160.overview: Making his Broadway debut, legendary comic Jeff Ross turns the spotlight on himself in a one-man show that is as heartfelt as it is hilarious.

movie:1582328.name: Love At Last
movie:1582328.overview: The funny story of Aslı, an advertising executive who doesn't want to be alone on Valentine's Day.

movie:1428294.name: Mrithyunjay
movie:1428294.overview: An intense murder investigation unfolds when a man refuses to accept a death casually deemed natural by the police. As he digs deeper, what begins as doubt turns into a relentless pursuit of truth, uncovering layers of deception and danger

movie:1649249.name: Derrick Stroup: Nostalgic
movie:1649249.overview: Stroup dives into his experience being a '90s kid in rural Alabama and everything that came along with it.

movie:1611487.name: Kill Tony: Once Upon a Time in Texas
movie:1611487.originalTitle: Kill Tony: Once Upon a Time in Texas
movie:1611487.overview: One minute. One mic. No mercy. Tony Hinchcliffe and a panel of famous guests put up-and-coming comedians to the test at a relentless Austin showcase.

movie:1616700.name: Mo Gilligan: In the Moment
movie:1616700.overview: Mo Gilligan takes on Hollywood — and lives to tell the tale. In this lively special, the Londoner dishes on fame, family and being British in America.

movie:1567555.name: Family Business
movie:1567555.overview: A poor family struggles to survive through petty theft, but the father decides to abandon crime after an incident that nearly lands him in prison. He devises a different plan: each family member gets a job working for a wealthy family, concealing their familial ties. They constantly confront the stark contrast between their own world and that of their employers.

movie:1466978.name: Mikael: Hunter of Two Realms
movie:1466978.overview: An elite police officer who is also a jinn hunter, facing the threat of creatures from the supernatural while investigating a series of gruesome murders leading to an epic battle against the Jinn King for the sake of balance between the two worlds.

movie:1423251.name: Biker
movie:1423251.overview: A seasoned motocross rider returns to the grueling sport he once abandoned, confronting fierce competition and a father who might push him to the brink.

movie:1596294.name: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
movie:1596294.originalTitle: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
movie:1596294.overview: Blurring the line between performance and personal crisis, comedian Maria Bamford turns her mental health journey into material that’s riotously funny and ultimately inspiring. What emerges is a portrait of an artist transforming vulnerability into creative strength through honesty.

movie:1054493.name: Pennum Porattum
movie:1054493.overview: When a woman and her dog face public hostility, a village's hidden tensions erupt. A stark examination of mob mentality, social judgment, and how communities can turn cruel when seeking to punish perceived wrongs.

movie:1622032.name: Sommore: Chandelier Fly
movie:1622032.overview: Get ready for comedic royalty as the Undisputed Queen of Comedy, Sommore, returns to Detroit for her 7th special, performing up close and personal at the Garden Theatre, recorded on June 28th.

movie:1535392.name: Malaikat Malam
movie:1535392.overview: Azam, a motorcycle workshop owner, balances his daily life activities between caring for his older brother who struggles with depression, participating in illegal street racing, and winning an innocent blind girl's heart.

movie:1633410.name: Bruce Bruce: I Ain't Playin'
movie:1633410.overview: Bruce Bruce returns after 14 years with his Netflix debut "I Ain't Playin'" - observing generational chaos and life's craziness through personal stories.

movie:1653459.name: Shabab Albomb 3
movie:1653459.overview: Amer plans to travel with his friends this summer, but his desire clashes with his family's insistence on accompanying them as well. The problem seems minor at first, but it pales in comparison to the surprises that await them upon their arrival.

movie:1623070.name: Deaw Still Alive
movie:1623070.originalTitle: เดี่ยว สติล อะไลฟ์
movie:1623070.overview: Comedian Udom Taephanich shares candid stories from his chaotic life, from superstition and dark rituals to his time in Korea.

movie:1335092.name: Sampradayaini Suppini Suddapusaani
movie:1335092.overview: After the accidental murder of a police sergeant, a man and his family are forced to cover up their tracks to avoid suspicion.

movie:1613035.name: The Lotto Winner
movie:1613035.overview: It follows an ordinary family whose lives are abruptly transformed by extraordinary luck—unraveling how money can both bind people together and quietly pull them apart.

movie:1630264.name: A Special Memory
movie:1630264.overview: The illness challenges the couple's love in a way they never anticipated, shifting the narrative from a sweet romance to an emotional journey.

movie:1528577.name: Bunny!!
movie:1528577.overview: A host of a relationship advice television programme starts to see cracks in her own marriage after the appearance of a mysterious guest.

movie:1390575.name: Nukkad Naatak
movie:1390575.overview: After being caught robbing the college canteen, best friends Molshri and Shivang are expelled. To be reinstated, they must enroll five children from an impoverished slum into a local school.

movie:1660940.name: Nee Forever
movie:1660940.overview: A Gen Z couple meets via dating app. Their relationship unfolds with unexpected consequences.

movie:1654069.name: Past Is Past
movie:1654069.overview: In this comedy special, Alex Calleja shares his unflinching observations about his family, personal failures and the oddities of life in the Philippines.

movie:1272837.name: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
movie:1272837.overview: Dr. Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship - with consequences that could change the world as they know it - and Spike's encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.

movie:1297842.name: GOAT
movie:1297842.overview: A small goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity, co-ed, full-contact sport dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

movie:1367642.name: Reminders of Him
movie:1367642.overview: When Diem's custodial grandparents adamantly refuse Kenna's attempts to see her daughter, Kenna discovers unexpected compassion, and then something truer and deeper, with former NFL player and local bar owner Ledger. As their secret romance develops, so do the dangers for both of them, leading Kenna toward heartbreak and, ultimately, the hope for a second chance.

movie:1263012.name: Dead Man's Wire
movie:1263012.overview: In 1977, former real estate developer Tony Kiritsis puts a dead man's switch on himself and the mortgage banker who did him wrong, demanding $5 million and a personal apology.

movie:1464883.name: The President's Cake
movie:1464883.overview: While people across 1990’s Iraq struggle to survive, 9-year-old Lamia has been selected to prepare a cake to celebrate the President’s birthday. In a landscape of fear and scarcity, where basic ingredients are nearly impossible to find, Lamia sets out on a determined journey throughout the big city in search of eggs, flour, and sugar. Accompanied by her grandmother, her loyal friend Saeed, and her pet rooster Hindi, she navigates vendors and police officers along the way.

movie:1450257.name: Clika
movie:1450257.overview: Aspiring small-town musician Chito is determined to make it big. When a clip of him performing one of his songs goes viral, he seizes the opportunity and pushes to carve out a place for himself in the new wave of Mexican-American music... and ultimately gets caught in a game more dangerous than anticipated.

movie:1125701.name: Midwinter Break
movie:1125701.overview: Longtime retired couple Stella and Gerry realise that their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

movie:1400731.name: André Is an Idiot
movie:1400731.overview: André, a brilliant idiot, is dying because he didn’t get a colonoscopy. His sobering diagnosis, complete irreverence, and insatiable curiosity, send him on an unexpected journey learning how to die happily and ridiculously without losing his sense of humor.

movie:1672938.name: Making of Lord of the Flies
movie:1672938.originalTitle: Making of Lord of the Flies
movie:1672938.overview: A trippy tale capturing the creative vision of writer Jack Thorne and director Marc Munden, as a British crew and young cast film this timely adaptation on the remote islands of Malaysia during monsoon season. The crew battle twisters, torrential rain and scary insects to create this hallucinatory fever dream, featuring behind-the-scenes interviews and mesmerising performances by the newbie cast.

movie:1625901.name: The Dating App Killer: The Monica White Story
movie:1625901.originalTitle: The Dating App Killer: The Monica White Story
movie:1625901.overview: A divorcee reenters the dating pool by creating an online profile, but when her match displays unsettling behavior and a series of women from the same dating site go missing, she must save herself from becoming the next victim.

movie:1633513.name: To Catch a Cheater
movie:1633513.overview: When her teenage daughter dies under mysterious circumstances, a mother's search for truth unravels a chain of lies and betrayal among her closest friends, forcing her to confront evil in her own circle.

movie:1648760.name: The Seemingly Perfect Family
movie:1648760.overview: Inspired by true events. When 18-year-old Lexi ages out of the foster care system and lies to get an au pair job, the dream family she is working for turns out to be a nightmare as she uncovers their twisted secrets. Rylee Reagan stars.

series:60735.name: The Flash
series:60735.overview: After being struck by lightning, CSI investigator Barry Allen awakens from a nine-month coma to discover he has been granted the gift of super speed. Teaming up with S.T.A.R. Labs, Barry takes on the persona of The Flash, the Fastest Man Alive, to protect his city.

series:456.name: The Simpsons
series:456.overview: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. Since the beginning, the series has been a pop culture icon, attracting hundreds of celebrities to guest star. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.

series:18165.name: The Vampire Diaries
series:18165.overview: The story of two vampire brothers obsessed with the same girl, who bears a striking resemblance to the beautiful but ruthless vampire they knew and loved in 1864.

series:1408.name: House
series:1408.overview: Dr. Gregory House, a drug-addicted, unconventional, misanthropic medical genius, leads a team of diagnosticians at the fictional Princeton–Plainsboro Teaching Hospital in New Jersey.

series:1413.name: American Horror Story
series:1413.overview: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, including a house with a murderous past, an asylum, a witch coven, a freak show, a hotel, a farmhouse in Roanoke, a cult, the apocalypse and a summer camp.

series:1100.name: How I Met Your Mother
series:1100.overview: A father recounts to his children - through a series of flashbacks - the journey he and his four best friends took leading up to him meeting their mother.

series:2316.name: The Office
series:2316.overview: The everyday lives of office employees in the Scranton, Pennsylvania branch of the fictional Dunder Mifflin Paper Company.

series:5920.name: The Mentalist
series:5920.overview: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic medium, uses his razor sharp skills of observation and expertise at "reading" people to solve serious crimes with the California Bureau of Investigation.

series:4057.name: Criminal Minds
series:4057.overview: An elite team of FBI profilers analyze the country's most twisted criminal minds, anticipating their next moves before they strike again. The Behavioral Analysis Unit's most experienced agent is David Rossi, a founding member of the BAU who returns to help the team solve new cases.

series:1421.name: Modern Family
series:1421.overview: The Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan is a wonderfully large and blended family. They give us an honest and often hilarious look into the sometimes warm, sometimes twisted, embrace of the modern family.

series:57243.name: Doctor Who
series:57243.overview: The Doctor is a Time Lord: a 900 year old alien with 2 hearts, part of a gifted civilization who mastered time travel. The Doctor saves planets for a living—more of a hobby actually, and the Doctor's very, very good at it.

series:1400.name: Seinfeld
series:1400.overview: A stand-up comedian and his three offbeat friends weather the pitfalls and payoffs of life in New York City in the '90s. It's a show about nothing.

series:60572.name: Pokémon
series:60572.overview: Join Ash accompanied by his partner Pikachu, as he travels through many regions, meets new friends and faces new challenges on his quest to become a Pokémon Master.

series:1877.name: Phineas and Ferb
series:1877.overview: Each day, two kindhearted suburban stepbrothers on summer vacation embark on some grand new project, which annoys their controlling sister, Candace, who tries to bust them. Meanwhile, their pet platypus plots against evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

series:2025.name: Beverly Hills, 90210
series:2025.overview: Follow the lives of a group of teenagers living in the upscale, star-studded community of Beverly Hills, California and attending the fictitious West Beverly Hills High School and, subsequently, the fictitious California University after graduation.

series:37678.name: The Voice
series:37678.overview: The strongest vocalists from across the United states compete in a blockbusters vocal competition, the winner becomes “The Voice.” The show's innovative format features four stages of competition: the blind auditions, the battle rounds, the knockouts and, finally, the live performance shows.

series:249565.name: The Good Daughter
series:249565.overview: Sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she’s forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

game:16944.name: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition

game:17822.name: The Witcher: Enhanced Edition Director's Cut

movie:687163.name: Project Hail Mary
movie:687163.overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

movie:1101412.name: Fall 2: Deadpoint
movie:1101412.overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

movie:1283515.name: Verity
movie:1283515.overview: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

movie:1058424.name: Hope
movie:1058424.overview: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

movie:1507696.name: Apocalypse Z: New World
movie:1507696.overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

movie:1813355.name: A Story of Derry
movie:1813355.overview: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

movie:1244523.name: Beware Boiúna
movie:1244523.overview: A medical mission deep in the Amazon becomes a desperate fight for survival when a colossal ancient predator awakens, turning the jungle into a deadly battleground where nature decides who lives and dies.

movie:1518204.name: Allen
movie:1518204.overview: 20 years after his encounter with an alien, Petey never moved on. Now his old friend has returned, and the reason why is complicated — and unexpected.

movie:1562642.name: Ghost Soldier
movie:1562642.overview: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

movie:1391325.name: Uncle Trouble +2
movie:1391325.overview: When Toni Benetón thinks he has everything under control in his lovable and fun multicultural family, the arrival of two new babies turns the house, and the whole family, upside down. Problems double, but so do the adventures.

series:272608.name: Chicken Shop Date
series:272608.overview: Amelia Dimoldenberg meets a celebrity guest at a local chicken shop for a date, engaging in casual, awkward, and sometimes flirtatious conversation.

movie:1131943.name: Madden
movie:1131943.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

movie:1551025.name: Guarding Stars
movie:1551025.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

series:1622.name: Supernatural
series:1622.overview: When they were boys, Sam and Dean Winchester lost their mother to a mysterious and demonic supernatural force. Subsequently, their father raised them to be soldiers. He taught them about the paranormal evil that lives in the dark corners and on the back roads of America ... and he taught them how to kill it. Now, the Winchester brothers crisscross the country in their '67 Chevy Impala, battling every kind of supernatural threat they encounter along the way.

series:1434.name: Family Guy
series:1434.overview: Sick, twisted, politically incorrect and Freakin' Sweet animated series featuring the adventures of the dysfunctional Griffin family. Bumbling Peter and long-suffering Lois have three kids. Stewie (a brilliant but sadistic baby bent on killing his mother and taking over the world), Meg (the oldest, and is the most unpopular girl in town) and Chris (the middle kid, he's not very bright but has a passion for movies). The final member of the family is Brian - a talking dog and much more than a pet, he keeps Stewie in check whilst sipping Martinis and sorting through his own life issues.

series:32573.name: Strike Back
series:32573.overview: The series follows John Porter, a former British Special Forces soldier, who is drafted back into service by Section 20, a fictional branch of the Secret Intelligence Service.

series:307853.name: Sunshine through the Rain
series:307853.overview: Two struggling biology students, initially rivals for a scholarship, find mutual support and solace, transforming their relationship from competition to companionship.
